conditions: This applies to identifiers in programs governed by ISO/IEC 7185:1990.
limitations: The rule concerns identifier spelling, independent of case in the contents of character strings or extensions in later dialects.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: ISO/IEC 7185:1990 requires Pascal identifier spelling to disregard letter case and bars identifiers with the spelling of a word-symbol.
